limitations: Not a classification of all initial conditions, bounded attractors, or d<0. The sufficient large-coordinate cutoff depends on parameters; no sharp escape boundary is asserted.
public_source_date_basis: An author-uploaded public preprint record is dated 2021-10-06, preceding the journal article dated 2022-06-24; the source equations and MSC are verified from the journal full text.
scientific_integrity: The proof uses exact differential identities, strict invariant-tube inequalities and an analytic Lyapunov comparison. The algebraic checker confirms identities only; no finite computation substitutes for the infinite-time argument. Independent audit has not occurred.
scientific_scope: Open basins of finite-time escape in the Hu–Sang–Wang hyperbolic-sine jerk flow for arbitrary fixed real a and epsilon and strictly positive b, c, d; universal logarithmic profile and blow-up-time bounds.
title: Finite-time escape and universal blow-up scaling in a dissipative hyperbolic-sine jerk flow
